versions.changelog: Fixed CPT licensing claim, added PHI warning, clarified CMS API endpoint and data scope
Fixed inaccurate formulary claim; added explicit PHI/privacy warning
Added GitHub repository link, homepage, and MIT LICENSE file

Initial release of the Medical Billing Coder skill.

- Suggests ICD-10, CPT, and E&M codes from clinical notes or plain-language descriptions with confidence scores and audit trail.
- Validates code combinations for payer compliance and flags upcoding, undercoding, and common denial triggers.
- Supports lookups and superbill generation for diagnosis, procedures, and visit levels.
- Provides reimbursement estimates and coding tips.
- Includes quick references for frequently used ICD-10 and CPT codes.
- All code suggestions require review by a qualified medical coder or clinician before claim submission.
